import json, os, random, subprocess, sys, time
rng = random.Random(5)
# maximum-size request: 1024 windows across 8 epochs with wide eligibility
cases = []
for e in range(8):
    nslots = 64
    slots = [[t*10, 2, 0 if i==0 else 1] for i,t in enumerate(range(nslots))]
    flows = [[4, 8, -1, i%7] for i in range(8)]
    windows = []
    for j in range(128):
        windows.append([rng.randrange(8), rng.randint(0,50), rng.randint(100, 700), rng.randint(1,65535),
                        rng.randint(1,320), rng.randint(0,65535), rng.randint(1,1000),
                        [[rng.randint(0,1500), rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]])
    cases.append({"model": "cnn" if e%2 else "rnn", "class_values":[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],
                  "stats":[rng.randint(1,1000)]*3, "bucket":[64,64], "slots":slots, "flows":flows,
                  "groups":[], "windows":windows})
req = {"version":3,"cases":cases}
raw = json.dumps(req).encode()
print('input size %.2f MiB' % (len(raw)/1024/1024))
env=dict(os.environ); env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']='/workspace/native'
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,
                 stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env,timeout=600)
print('-> %.2fs exit=%d stdout=%.2f MiB stderr=%s' % (time.time()-t, p.returncode, len(p.stdout)/1024/1024, p.stderr.decode()[:300]))
resp = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('results:', len(resp['results']), 'first ratio', resp['results'][0]['ratio'])
PYEOF
